manifest.source: HMDB-51 (Kuehne et al. 2011; CC BY 4.0), from the Hugging Face mirror MichiganNLP/hmdb that the Serre lab page links (hmdb51_org.zip, a ZIP repack of the official RAR; the lab's own download links returned 404 on 2026-11-22; every clip is stored twice with the same CRC and is used once), official split 1 (test_train_splits.zip: label 2 = test clips, label 1 = training clips, the reference pool for dev). 51 classes, about 6.8k clips; many clips are short and low quality, which is part of why it is a useful second set. 8 frames per clip at 64x64 decoded by the app; ResNet-18 ImageNet embedding averaged over frames; pixel and shared-pattern checks on the temporal mean of the 8 frames (32x32). Attacks on decoded frames.
manifest.policy: New held-out dataset: nothing was tuned on HMDB-51; the detector is frozen at fb3ab71 (its video results reproduce manifest-video-v2 exactly; the commit is recorded in the result) and the result is quoted once. Never edit this file in place: create a new benchmark_id for any change.
